reviews.t: Best flat top wax I've ever used
reviews.x: Best flat top wax I've ever used.  I used Krew Comb for years and then switched to the Crew Pomade because it was more widely available.  Moving forward, this will be a staple in my personal hygiene product drawer.

This is the product my barber has used on me for years....was glad to find it from a seller at a reasonable price with shipping included.  This is definately for folks with short hair (per other reviews)

claims.text: Long-time users praise it as a classic, old-fashioned product that has been used for decades, especially for flat tops, crew cuts, and military-style hair.
It provides strong hold and control, keeping hair in place even on windy days.
Some reviewers find it sticky and hard to apply, pulling at the hair during application.
Some reviewers note it is difficult to wash out, requiring multiple shampoos.
A few reviewers mention the consistency or quality seems weaker than in the past.
